purpose: Freeze new price inputs and development splits before any 2025 prediction evaluation.
price_policy: Store vendor OHLC, Adj Close, Volume and corporate actions. Do not mix this snapshot with the old price panel or treat retrieval-time adjustments as point-in-time vintages.
missing_policy: No forward fill or interpolation. Full NYSE 2025 session coverage required for every requested ticker; failures remain documented and prevent readiness. Prelisting development gaps are recorded.
holdout_policy: Separate files; no target distribution, price/return summaries, predictions, scores, charts or model selection from 2025 during preparation. Coverage and validity diagnostics are allowed.
purge_rule: Each label end must be strictly before the next segment starts. Five-session targets use the NYSE calendar, not the fifth available row after a missing bar.
future_experiment_gate: Confirm 2025 was not used for previous model selection; otherwise retain exploratory status or choose a future prospective window.
Register features, candidate models, calibration, selection rule, trial budget and cost-aware strategy before fitting candidates.
Use only development files for candidate selection and transformations.
Record the chosen artifact hashes and protocol before one final holdout evaluation. Preserve all results and never promote automatically.
limitations: Fixed survivor universe; not point-in-time membership.
Vendor data and adjustments can be revised; this is a retrieval-time snapshot.
Coverage does not establish price correctness or historical availability.
No newly aligned 2025 news data is included; finance-only preparation does not test sentiment.
A procedural split is not an access-control boundary or proof of no prior use.
